breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the inconsistency. The ground truth resolves the issue by removing the incorrect instruction to use the arithmetic-mean area and keeping the correct instruction to use the deformation integral. The generated specification does the opposite: it removes the correct integral formula and explicitly instructs the user to use the incorrect arithmetic-mean area for the calculation, thereby repeating the original error.
